orientation: palm_up: wrist quaternion [0.5,0.5,-0.5,-0.5], palm normal world +Z
pinch_definition: Two DIFFERENT fingertip/distal fingers each have net normal force above 0.02 N on the rod, with normalized directions cosine <= -0.3. Strict success requires opposing pinch >80% of the full 60 seconds plus the original quality gates.
migration: Resume only from the early correctly oriented palm-up checkpoint; never load palm-forward checkpoints. Exact scene/bank hash compatibility is checked. Four ring output rows and optimizer state reset once for the revised controller/objective.
limits: Real free rod and gravity; no weld, scripted pen trajectory or support fixtures. Surviving alone is not success. The generic runner uses survival as the curriculum progression gate; strict final task success additionally requires tracking and opposing pinch.
